'''Astrophysics''' was a field of scientific study. The [[Hypernautics|study]] of the theories and realities of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] fell under the purview of astrophysics.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Those who studied astrophysics were known as [[Astrophysicist/Legends|astrophysicists]].
